title: Discrete-Time Model of a Two-Speed PowerShift suitable for Real-Time Control and Simulation
summary: In this paper, a new discrete-time approach to model the clutches engagement/disengagement in a two-speed powershift is proposed. The core idea is the development of a model for the computation of the exact torque needed to achieve the clutches engagement, including both the cases of single clutch engagement and of simultaneous clutch engagement (full lock condition). Based on this, the control logic for the clutches engagement and disengagement phases is also developed.
